verdict: Paid ads have been off since Aug 6; organic is holding steady.
narrative: All 21 leads and $574.80 in ad spend this period came before August 6 — paid activity has been at zero for the 20 days since. Your Google My Business profile continued to generate organic interest, with 169 profile actions and 56 calls this period, which is what is keeping visibility alive right now. The 26 contacts recorded have not yet moved into active pipeline, and we are addressing that intake gap with SMS automation and CRM logging going live by August 31. Once paid campaigns are back on, you can expect lead volume to resume at the efficiency baseline that was in place before the pause — roughly $27 per lead.
